title: Todd and the Almost Ocean
synopsis: Todd and Sue give a small rain puddle an enormous name on a grown-up-accompanied walk to Round Pond.
continuity_state: Before: Sue now knows Amy, Ben, Kim and their homes in general, but has not yet met Todd. Todd and Aunt Pat live in Reed Meadow. Todd has two yellow boots, one patched blue. Only Pebble Bridge crosses the creek. After: Sue meets Todd beside the adult-visible dry path near Round Pond, after Grandpa Ed and Sue walk from orchard through Village Green and across Pebble Bridge. A temporary rain puddle is jokingly called the Almost Ocean; it is not marked as permanent geography. Sue sees Round Pond for the first time and Todd shows the route back. They part with adults along the established east/west directions. Boots and belongings unchanged.
